_meta.gym_name: Test Gym B (synthetic, configurability test only)
_meta._notes: Synthetic Level-2 config used by lib/analytics/__tests__/test_gym_b.test.ts to prove the engine reads config — same engine, different channels, different conversion metrics, different velocity buckets, different exclusions, different active-status value, no Level-3 module. If this fixture's numbers come out right, configurability works.

member_status_values._notes: Synthetic-fixture values. The literal string 'Active' does NOT appear in real ABC data — the canonical active value at Powerhouse is 'Ok' (see PROJECT.md deviation). 'Active'/'Pending' are used here only to prove the engine reads `active_value` / `pending_cancel_value` from config rather than hardcoding any string.

velocity_buckets._notes: Three buckets at different cuts than Powerhouse's four — proves the engine respects bucket geometry from config.

Online Sales Conversion.numerator: count(sales where attributed_channel=online AND queue_date in period)
Online Sales Conversion.denominator: count(leads where channel=online AND created_at in period)
Online Sales Conversion._notes: Key follows the <channel>_<formula> convention: the engine parses it as (channel='online', formula='sales_conversion'). This is the same universal formula Powerhouse uses for 'web_sales_conversion' / 'walk_in_sales_conversion' — proves the formula is channel-agnostic.

display_labels._notes: Exercises the Level-2 display-label override path. Renames the totals-row keys so the engine cannot use its built-in 'Total Leads' / 'Total Sales' defaults — proves both that the override is honored AND that the defaults remain a fallback when other tiles do not set an override.
